title: Boosting hydrogen peroxide photosynthetic efficiency via enhanced adsorption of small water clusters
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE05698E, Paper
Rong Gao, Mengyang Xia, Yihan Deng, Bo Yang, Niu Huang, Yingping Huang, Hui Li, Lei Bao, Wei Liu, Tianyi Ma, Liqun Ye
The incorporation of sulfonate groups facilitated the small water clusters formation, which mitigated the competition posed by the water oxidation and facilitated the hydrogen extraction from water molecules for the alkaline photosynthesis of H2O2.
